title: Design System: AI Engineer Portfolio - Aurora Field

headline.purpose: Archivo 700 hero greeting clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.2rem), 0.62em soft sub-line.

body.purpose: Inter 17px/1.65 prose; bubbles 15px/1.6; tabular numerals on data.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono 10.5-13px uppercase furniture, 0.06-0.12em tracking, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: glass-pill
shadows.purpose: Top pill and card-nav cards at rest; deepens on hover.

shadows.name: ask-float
shadows.purpose: Permanent float of the ask bar above paper.

shadows.name: sheet-rest
shadows.purpose: System cards, pipeline sheet, spec shelf, build log.

shadows.name: avatar-float
shadows.purpose: Playful float of the 168px round avatar.

shadows.name: contact-rest
shadows.purpose: Contact grid sits highest; link hover adds blue glow.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: All hover and state motion: lifts, inverts, node transitions.

motion.name: aurora-drift
motion.purpose: Five blobs drift 22-32s ease-in-out infinite alternate (26/32/24/29/22s).

motion.name: pointer-follow
motion.value: lerp 0.06, per-layer depths 0.35-1.7 x 9vmax + cursor glow
motion.purpose: Aurora leans toward pointer: 0.06 lerp per frame, each layer at its own depth (0.35/0.6/0.9/1.25/1.7 x 9vmax), no CSS transition; 340px glow tracks cursor directly. Skipped on coarse pointers and reduced motion.

motion.name: pipeline-phase
motion.purpose: RAG demo advances one node per 650ms tick (+97 tokens/step).

motion.name: edge-flow
motion.purpose: Live pipeline edges dash-flow while a phase is active.

motion.name: typing-blink
motion.purpose: Ask-pill thinking dots blink on a 1s loop during the ~700ms placeholder answer delay.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Kills drift, edge flow, typing blink, smooth scroll, and all transitions.

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Round blue send button with arrow glyph; hover shifts to action-ink and scales.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="Send question"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 10h11M10 5.5 14.5 10 10 14.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { width: 46px; height: 46px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; cursor: pointer; background: #2f7bff; color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), background 0.2s; } .ds-send:hover { background: #1a56c4; transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7bff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ask Pill
components.description: Glass ask pill bar; transparent input with blue caret and soft placeholder.
components.css: .ds-askbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); border: 1px solid #e8e6e0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(20,20,23,0.1); max-width: 560px; } .ds-askbar input { flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #141417; caret-color: #2f7bff; } .ds-askbar input::placeholder { color: #55565c; }

components.name: Top Pill
components.description: Left-aligned glass builder pill with ink mark; lifts on hover.
components.html: BBuild your AI portfolio›
components.css: .ds-toppill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border: 1px solid #e8e6e0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #141417; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(20,20,23,0.06); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-toppill:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(20,20,23,0.1); } .ds-toppill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7bff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-mark { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; background: #141417; color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Glass Nav Card
components.description: Glass nav card with authored stroke icon; lifts 4px and inks on hover.
components.html: Skills

components.css: .ds-node { border: 1px solid #141417; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; padding: 14px 12px; min-height: 118px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 150px; transition: background 0.5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), border-color 0.3s, transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1); } .ds-node .ds-ntop { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #61626a; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-node .ds-nname { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 16px; color: #141417; } .ds-node .ds-nval { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #55565c; margin-top: auto; } .ds-node.live { border-color: #2f7bff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e5efff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-node.live .ds-ntop { color: #1a56c4; } .ds-node.done { background: #141417; color: #fff; } .ds-node.done .ds-ntop, .ds-node.done .ds-nval { color: #cfccc2; } .ds-node.done .ds-nname { color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: An airy daylight portfolio where a five-hue fluid field drifts on parallax layers behind everything and leans toward the visitor's cursor, with a cursor glow. One centered hero front door - eyebrow, greeting, giant title, round avatar, ask pill, five glass nav cards - with one route per card (/me, /projects, /skills, /fun, /contact) sharing field, nav (current route ringed), and footer. Density is calm and centered: a 1080px wrap, generous whitespace, glass pills and cards, one action blue reserved for send controls and links.
keyCharacteristics: Airy paper ground with drifting five-hue aurora, never dark mode.
One action blue committed to send + links; field hues never carry text.
Archivo display, Inter body calm, JetBrains Mono for all data labels.
Glass pills (999px), glass nav cards (18px), light pipeline sheet (20px).
Placeholders always marked synthetic (*, dashed notes); never styled as finished proof.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action blue (#2F7BFF) marks send + links + live flow only. Field hues are atmosphere.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: The world is always lit: paper ground (#FAFAF7), white glass lifts, ink lines. No dark-mode inversion, no neon glow, no schematic grid.

rules.name: The Mono Furniture Rule
rules.body: Metadata is JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked 0.06-0.12em. Body copy never wears mono.

rules.name: The Balance Rule
rules.body: Display, headline, section heads, system titles, and contact heads always balance-wrap.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadow appears only as ambient lift under glass and grows on hover - never as an offset or outline.

dos: Do keep the field atmospheric: five hues drift on parallax layers and follow at 0.06 lerp with a cursor glow; text and controls always sit on paper/glass above it.
Do reserve action blue (#2F7BFF) for send + links + live flow; status hues for lamps and pulse only.
Do set all furniture in JetBrains Mono with 0.06-0.12em tracking and tabular numerals for metrics.
Do collapse to one column at 900px (rotating pipeline edges 90 degrees) and freeze the field on touch and reduced motion.
Do mark every placeholder synthetic - asterisk, placeholder tag, dashed note, or disabled dashed button - never as plain finished copy.
Do honor reduced motion: no drift, no edge flow, no typing blink, no transitions.
donts: Don't introduce dark surfaces, neon glows, schematic grids, or a second accent hue.
Don't set body copy in mono or metadata in Inter - furniture is mono, prose is Inter, display is Archivo.
Don't put text directly on aurora hues or use field hues for borders and states.
Don't sharpen the geometry; pills stay 999px, nav cards 18px, sheets 20px, contact 24px.
Don't invent employers, testimonials, metrics, or press; placeholders stay obviously replaceable.
